question: Can negative serial dependence in recorded trade prices establish a reversal signal or qualified execution spread without quote evidence?
scope: Discovery documentary and small-file identity/schema check only; no numerical market experiment or research claim.
prior_exposure: Roll publisher sections I-II and current RPI help already read before this protocol. Existing candles are exposed development data. No covariance inspected.
minimal_check: Verify existing 44KB candle ZIP hash and CSV header against required price/time observations; crosswalk primary-source assumptions to committed input qualifications. Reuse prior full data audit.
falsifier: Authoritative methodology and qualified target inputs establishing that the price-only statistic identifies executable costs without unresolved assumptions would overturn rejection of direct cost admission. This check cannot establish such target evidence.
stop: After source/input crosswalk and header check; do not scan prices, estimate covariance, download data or start research routes.
